svg.title: openfarm: Frontier thinks. The farm grinds. Code decides.
svg.desc: Banner for openfarm v0.5.0, a pre-release portable coding farm where frontier models architect and review, cheaper models do the compile and retry grind, and plain code runs every gate.
svg.text: Frontier thinks. The farm grinds. Code decides.
Your best model designs and reviews. A cheaper model does the grind.
Every gate is run by plain code, so no model ever grades its own work.
